scope: Preflight supports only exact structured mappings from work-authorization and sponsorship questions to their explicit saved career-profile preference fields. It does not infer, echo, or fill either response.

acceptance.explicit_structured_values: PASS; legally authorized-for-employment questions mapped only to preferences.work_authorization and sponsorship questions mapped only to preferences.sponsorship_needs pass when their saved values are explicit and unambiguous.
acceptance.missing_or_ambiguous_values: PASS; blank, unknown, unspecified, maybe, and not-sure work-authorization values plus NOT_SPECIFIED sponsorship remain UNKNOWN with LEGAL_PROFILE_VALUE_UNAVAILABLE and a question-only missing record.
acceptance.unrelated_legal_attestations: PASS; criminal-history, mismapped fields, combined fields, and unsupported paths remain UNKNOWN or UNMAPPED_REQUIRED_QUESTION.
acceptance.ordinary_question_control: PASS; an ordinary question satisfied by the existing approved answer mapping remains PASS.
acceptance.persistence_and_redaction: PASS; a connected preflight audit/readback persists the supported mapping but neither explicit profile value appears in the result or audit payload.
acceptance.pre_browser_stop: PASS; an unrelated required legal attestation transitions the synthetic application to REVIEW_REQUIRED before Playwright, with zero application-attempt rows.
acceptance.submission_safety: PASS; no external application submission path was invoked.

red_first_observation.details: The initial new integration tests failed because the supported dotted preference paths were rejected and all required legal questions were classified as unexpected sensitive questions.

checks.target: Synthetic SQLite/API preflight, durable audit readback, redaction, ordinary control, and pre-browser stop

environment.ATS: Local synthetic mock fixture; browser launch patched and asserted absent for the blocked case

limitations: Only the bounded preflight behavior is covered; broader application automation and all other legally significant profile fields remain outside this slice.
A passing preflight does not populate or submit legal responses; values remain private profile state and require downstream user handling.
Hosted checks and live employer ATS validation were not run.
